[[File:Anti-Vehicle_Explosive.jpg|thumb|The [[Anti-Vehicle Explosive]], an example of an anti-vehicle grenade]]
An '''anti-vehicle grenade''' was designed to specifically target and eliminate vehicles. They sold for two hundred and fifty [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] apiece.<ref name="RASB">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref> [[Galentro Armaments]] produced the [[Anti-Vehicle Explosive]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="BFH">{{JournalCite|3|Blasters for Hire}}</ref>
